instructions.purpose: Try a new or changed automation script against real data before anything is saved.

tool.name: automation-preview
tool.description: Stores an immutable draft and runs it once in the sandbox with a copy of the live automation's state; nothing is committed. On success returns previewId, input (allowedOrigins, config, outputCapBytes, fetched URLs with status and bytes), output (outcome plus text or data), and logs. On failure returns success false, the error, fetches, and logs, and no previewId.

usage_rules.rule: Pass config as a JSON object, never as a JSON string. Put every parameter (URLs, coordinates, thresholds) in config instead of hardcoding it in source.
allowedOrigins lists only the origins the script fetches, e.g. https://api.open-meteo.com. Use an empty list when the script fetches nothing.
Reuse the saved automation's exact name when editing or fixing it; a new name creates a new automation.
On failure, read the error, fetches, and logs, fix the script, and preview again. Never report a failed preview as ready.
Every change, however small, needs a new preview; only the latest successful previewId reflects it.
Set outputCapBytes only when the output does not fit the 16384-byte default, and report the increase so the user approves it with the preview.

example.context: User wants the Warsaw temperature every morning.

toolCall.name: warsaw-weather
